initial_decision.brief_rationale: The standardized difference of 0.14 is arithmetically correct, but the received evidence does not establish that adjusting for Z identifies the causal effect. Request archived design record R217-2 to assess identification.

final_decision.brief_rationale: R217-2 establishes conditional exchangeability, consistency, no interference, and positivity, identifying the causal effect by population standardization over Z. The risk difference is (100/250)(32/80−10/20)+(150/250)(81/90−36/60)=0.14.
